programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot
governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
negative_findings: Inherited canonical flat-crosser exposes exact intercept/physical lead and must remain hidden oracle/reference truth only.
Current target engine does not certify realistic clay aerodynamics; virtual-shooter results must retain provisional world-model status.
Current centreline evaluator is a 110 mm disc sensitivity proxy only; it does not model target orientation, shot cloud or breakability.
Naive point-at-extrapolated-target baseline is intentionally weak and achieved 0/12 proxy hits; it is a lower baseline, not a human-performance claim.
L1 stable-crosser apparent-path uncertainty is under-dispersed: clear azimuth 2-sigma coverage 0.667 and noisy coverage 0.750 on the first 12-target bank.
Perfect left/right direction accuracy on the small stable-crosser bank is an easy-task result, not general target-reading proof.
No Brett Winstanley hold/pickup/break-point claim promoted without a recovered primary source.
next_action: Build a larger partitioned L1 perception bank, calibrate uncertainty on calibration-only data, evaluate untouched held-out coverage/proper scoring, and add stronger short-window/partial-acquisition probes before allowing any gun or L2 planning.
